description: This file contains server-side utility functions for handling Next.js API routes, including request parsing, response handling, preview data management, and error handling.

classes.name: ApiError
classes.description: Custom error class for API errors, includes HTTP status code.

methods.name: apiResolver
methods.description: Main function to resolve API requests, handling parsing, resolver invocation, and error handling.

methods.name: parseBody
methods.description: Parses the request body based on content type, supporting JSON, URL-encoded, and raw data.

methods.name: getCookieParser
methods.description: Returns a function to parse cookies from the request headers.

methods.name: sendStatusCode
methods.description: Sets the HTTP status code on the response.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Performs an HTTP redirect with specified status or URL.

methods.name: sendData
methods.description: Sends data in the response, handling streams, buffers, and JSON.

methods.name: sendJson
methods.description: Sends a JSON object in the response.

methods.name: tryGetPreviewData
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve preview data from cookies and decrypts it.

methods.name: setPreviewData
methods.description: Sets preview data cookies with encrypted payload.

methods.name: sendError
methods.description: Sends an error response with status code and message.

methods.name: setLazyProp
methods.description: Defines a property on the request object with lazy evaluation.
